worlds.null: Nothing happens. Every term is exactly 0. Anything reported is noise.
worlds.intrinsic_only: Mature cells stay and go quiet. Compositional exactly 0 -- the positive control for the intrinsic arm.
worlds.compositional_only: Mature cells leave; survivors are unchanged. Intrinsic exactly 0, so any intrinsic signal reported here is manufactured.
worlds.depleted_estimable: Heavy depletion AND silencing, ~100 mature cells left. Both terms real and both estimable -- refusing here would be a false negative.
worlds.depleted_wide: ~20 mature cells: the wide-interval regime. Defined but barely.
worlds.annihilated: NO mature tumour cell survives. The intrinsic estimand does not exist. This is the world the whole benchmark is for.

skipped_methods.cacoa: cacoa is not installed; env/w4_estimator.yml pins r-devtools and cacoa installs from GitHub (kharchenkolab/cacoa). Not run, not skipped silently.

SYNTHETIC: Every number here comes from simulated cells with analytically known truth. Nothing in this directory is a result about colorectal cancer.
